name: Light Up
rules: Light every white cell. A bulb lights its row and column up to a black cell, no bulb may shine on another, and a number says how many bulbs touch that cell.
technique.1: This cell can only be lit from one place, so a bulb must go there.
technique.2: This number already touches all the bulbs it asks for, so the other cells next to it must stay empty.
technique.3: This number still needs a bulb in every free cell next to it, so put a bulb in each of them.
technique.4: At least one of the highlighted cells must hold a bulb, and a bulb in this cell would rule all of them out, so this cell must stay empty.
demo.1: Place bulbs until every white cell is lit.
demo.2: A bulb lights its own row and column, as far as the black cells.
demo.3: A number counts the bulbs next to it. This 4 needs one on each side.
demo.4: This corner is still dark, and nothing else can reach it, so it takes a bulb of its own.
demo.5: No bulb may shine on another. These two are in the same column with nothing between them.
demo.6: Every white cell is lit, the 4 has its four bulbs, and no bulb shines on another.
